I replied to Marcus in the #north-team thread: the main contact for the door 6 duplicate arrivals at Quarrendon Freight Lines is **Thea Ramaswell**.

- **Where it came from:** Dana's post in #north-team on Aug 20, 2025, which Marcus can see. She wrote that Thea had flagged the door 6 duplicates again on the morning shift. The same trailer was checked in twice at 06:30, once at the kiosk and once added manually by dispatch.
- **Her title:** Director of Yard Operations. This comes only from the North team notes in the knowledge base. I didn't put it in front of Marcus as coming from a channel he can see.
- **Current status:** I couldn't find any update after that post, so I pointed Marcus to Dana, who owns the account.

I left out the seat counts from that same message because they weren't part of his question.
